title: Project boundary check
description: Check direct workspace project dependencies against tag constraints.

project.description: Check only this project’s direct outgoing project dependencies. Omit to check the workspace.

outputFile.description: Optional JSON report path, relative to the workspace root or absolute. For parallel project tasks use {boundaryProjectName}, expanded to project- plus the full lowercase SHA-256 digest of the UTF-8 encoding of the selected name. Requires project selection.
